lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hi Keisha, this is Jorge. Is this an okay time to talk?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi Jorge. Give me one second... okay, I'm here.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Before we start, is there anything on your mind you want to make sure we get to today?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Actually, I had a question about fruit at night.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What happened with the walking?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Zero. I'm not going to lie to you.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's been a mixed week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A short walk after dinner, even 10 minutes, really helps bring blood sugar down.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, with all the rain I just stayed in.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: A short walk after dinner, even 10 minutes, really helps bring blood sugar down.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I already told my family about my goal.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: So, I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How would things be different if you kept this up?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I know I can do it, I did it before.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You know your schedule better than anyone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What could you try instead?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I mean, I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. After dinner I can walk the dog, she needs it anyway.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to be around and be well for the people you love.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've got a plan in mind already.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Being around for my family is why I'm doing this.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What would your family say about these changes?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My sugar is lower in the morning when I walk after dinner. Church on Sunday always throws me off.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: This is about more than the walking. It's about getting your life back.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I really want to feel like myself again.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You want to feel like yourself again.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone. At least I'm trying.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Once you decide something, you follow through.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So what would you like your goal to be for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Let's say I take a 10-minute walk after dinner on 3 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If it rains I'll walk in the hallway of my building.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 0 out of 5 days, the hard part was being so tired, and next week you're going to take a 10-minute walk after dinner on 3 days. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, and I'll really try this time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Tuesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Can we do a little later? I have an appointment.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Keisha, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thanks, bye bye.

flags.reason: Verbatim repeat of line 11 after participant raised a barrier; pushes advice without permission.
Participant's fruit-at-night question (line 4) was never addressed or revisited.
Summary says the hard part was being tired; participant said the rain kept her in. Misstated content.
Coach answered change talk ('I really want to feel like myself again') with a reframe rather than exploring it further; minor.

score.summary: Keisha moved from resistance to a concrete plan, with strong change talk emerging in the second half of the call. The coach repeated the same advice verbatim, skipped her fruit question, and misstated her barrier in the summary, which weakened the partnership.
strengths: Line 27: 'It's completely your call' restores autonomy after the advice pushback.
Lines 30, 38, 42: complex and simple reflections captured her values and desire to feel like herself.
Line 46: 'What might get in the way?' led to a concrete rain-day backup plan at line 47.
coaching_tips: Line 13 and 15 repeat earlier advice word for word; after a barrier, reflect the barrier instead of re-offering the same suggestion.
Line 5 skipped her fruit-at-night question at line 4; return to it or ask whether she wants to set it aside for later.
Line 48: check the summary against her words; she said rain kept her in, not tiredness.
Line 36: after 'I really want to feel like myself again,' ask her to say more before reframing it.
